# AA chart data notes

45 points: nine requested exact model families, five effort levels each. All data extracted from opened current AA comparison pages on 2026-10-14, approximately08:52–08:55UTC. Each successful page identifies Intelligence Index v4.3.2. No values substituted from launch posts. CSV/JSON cross-check passed.

Primary x=cost_usd is the source's Cost to Run Intelligence Index: total USD for its evaluations excluding repeats, based on token categories and prices. weighted_cost_per_task_usd is a separate, evaluation-weighted quantity. Neither is blended USD/MTok, subscription billing, or user quota. The two cost measures need not produce the same frontier. Prices, typical cache-hit rates and evaluation results can change; source rounds both scores and costs.

The composite has10evaluations with different sample sizes/repeats; n=null is intentional. Component sizes and weights are in JSON. Do not sum questions into one homogeneous n or label every point a single-run pass rate. AA primarily measures English/text capability, not Chinese prose or GEO outcomes. Source methodology: https://artificialanalysis.ai/methodology/intelligence-benchmarking

## Fallback caveat
Opus5.5 and Sonnet5.5 AA pages label Default Fallback. This can route safety-classifier refusals to another Claude model; it is not triggered by ordinary rate-limit/overload errors. Thus plotted results describe configurations, not necessarily pure single-model execution. Current per-effort fallback proportions were not found. AA's September28Sonnet article reported roughly0.1%task fallback, to Sonnet5, mainly Terminal-Bench; that historical fraction must not be presented as today's exact row statistic. Official explanation: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback ; historical disclosure: https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/claude-sonnet-5-5/

## Haiku pricing caveat
AA's current public point estimates are retained as published. Inclusion of Haiku's >100k prompt price uplift in these totals was not confirmed; AA's launch article disclosed its then-provisional costs omitted it. Mark Haiku costs as source-reported, tier treatment unverified. Do not silently reprice them or conclude these are actual bills.

## Pareto interpretation
Dominance can be calculated only within this45point snapshot and selected cost axis. Rounded equal scores are not proof of equal capability. If a frontier is drawn, label it sampled-configuration frontier; it does not prove a universal optimal model. Avoid pooling with ToneBench/Vulcan points on a shared capability axis.
raw_methods.coding:
# Coding chart data: nine models, 45 measured configurations

Retrieved and reconstructed on 2026-10-14 from VulcanBench's original run CSVs, not rounded screenshots. `coding.json` is an array of 45 rows; `coding.csv` contains the same fields. `raw/` retains original report HTML, source score CSVs, per-run CSVs and economics JSON. `build_coding.py` regenerates the normalized table. Each row contains both report and raw-data URLs.

## Recommended main chart

Title: Fixed coding-task framework: model + harness observations, not a controlled model-only experiment.

X = `cost_usd`, arithmetic average solver API-equivalent USD over all 23 attempts, logarithmic axis. Y = `score`, 100 × tasks passing every hidden test / 23. Label or tooltip with `passes`, effort, harness and dates. Use 43 cost-complete points; GPT-6 Luna xhigh/max belong in a separate missing-cost panel, not the main Pareto curve. Their known survivor-only averages must never be substituted for `cost_usd` or set to zero.

Every model has low, medium, high, xhigh and max. Source spelling extra-high is normalized to xhigh. A stronger reasoning setting is not a fixed compute or token multiplier shared across models. These rows describe an old-binary reconstruction suite, not general intelligence, frontend design, research, writing or browser ability.

## Population and scoring

The suite has 23 legacy binary reconstruction tasks with specifications that have documented behavior differences; one attempt per task/effort. Main pass-rate denominator always stays 23, including safeguard stops, timeouts and runs lacking judge scores. All passes are reconstructed from per-run `functional_pct == 100`, avoiding the source score cards that sometimes use a judged-only denominator. In particular GPT-5.6 Sol max is 22/23, not the judged-only 21/22.

The optional composite averages 50% functional correctness, 8.5% lint/complexity, 8.5% security and 33% model-judged code quality. Composite/quality denominators differ: Opus high 22; Haiku medium/xhigh 22, max 21; GPT-6 Sol medium 22; GPT-5.6 Sol max 22; GPT-6 Luna xhigh 21/max 19. Hence these cannot replace the consistent pass-rate main axis. `judged_n`, `missing_score_n` and raw scores are retained. A separate comparison can display composite with these denominators visibly labeled. Scores use two model judges, not human ratings. GPT-6.1 Sol medium contains one valid single-judge result.

## Cost caveats

- Cost is solver inference at list/API-equivalent rates, cache-aware, excluding judges and local infrastructure. These were subscription runs; amounts are not the user's subscription bill, credits or actual marginal cash cost.
- GPT-6 Luna xhigh has 21 priced of 23 and two timeouts; max has 19 priced and four timeouts. Full-population means are unknown. The subset means (~$0.159686 and ~$0.097529) describe different survivors; no max cost advantage can be inferred. Runtime averages include all 23.
- Astra central costs use standard pricing because receipts lack per-request context lengths. `long_context_upper_cost_usd` reproduces the report's conservative long-context scenario, not a statistical confidence interval. Display as a scenario/range when relevant, not measurement error.
- Haiku costs use Claude Code's own session list-price total over all runs. `cost_usd_floor`/`ceiling` apply the complete usage to each price tier and are pricing scenarios, not confidence bounds. Do not replace the observed CLI total with the cheaper tier.
- Opus costs include every serving model, including Opus 4.8 fallback. The report explicitly rejects an earlier estimate that omitted fallback usage; this dataset uses the corrected exported cost.
- GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol lack per-request context sizes; the source applied no long-context premium. All rates are source-date rates, not repriced to today's catalog.

## Comparability limits

Same task set and broad frozen scoring rubric, but dates and CLI versions differ. Model aliases are reported; immutable serving snapshots are not established. Opus used Claude Code 2.1.280; Sonnet 2.1.291–293; Haiku 2.1.293–296. Older GPT rows use Codex 0.153.4; GPT-6 Sol/Luna 0.155.0; GPT-6.1 Sol 0.159.0. Exact per-level sets and UTC run spans are in each row. Opus run date is available only as the report's Sep 22–24 date range.

Opus's refusal fallback was enabled: Opus 4.8 wrote 0.0%, 6.4%, 20.9%, 32.4%, 47.8% of replies from low to max. It is therefore a mixed model+harness result, particularly at max. Keep an asterisk on its legend. Sonnet fallback was enabled but unused. Haiku's classifier stops are counted, not hidden. Sonnet predates the tagged-worktree rule; its Grok judge used a newer Cursor CLI. Some GPT-6 Sol/6.1 solver work overlapped other judging on the same machine. None of these sweeps provides repeated runs per task/effort, so no small-gap causal or significance claim is supported.

Strict timeout comparability is also imperfect: GPT-5.6 Luna max has a completed run beyond three hours; GPT-6 Luna enforced three hours. `timeouts` describes source-status timeouts, not our retrospectively reclassifying long completed runs. `over_180_minutes_runs` flags clear >181-minute runs for audit (one-minute cushion avoids boundary rounding).

## Reading the data cautiously

On this suite, GPT-6.1 Sol high achieved 23/23 for ~$0.330/task, while medium achieved 22/23 for ~$0.399. Astra medium also achieved 23/23, averaged ~3.82 minutes rather than Sol high's ~10.22, at a central ~$1.481/task. These are distinct cost-vs-time choices, and top-end correctness saturates. Haiku xhigh and max both pass 22/23; xhigh costs less and completes faster in these runs. Opus medium passes 23/23, but comparisons to higher efforts are confounded by increasing fallback. Any plotted Pareto boundary is descriptive for this dataset and these cost estimates, not a universal recommendation or statistically secure frontier.

# ToneBench chart extraction

All 31 records come from one downloaded leaderboard.json snapshot: **2026-10-13 20:08 UTC**, retrieved October14. Full nine-model coverage. The JSON source, its SHA256, scoring fingerprint and each row's scorecard URL are retained. Numeric values use source precision; no values estimated or merged from older pages. The supplied Sonnet scorecard was October12, so its Elo was deliberately NOT used.

Files: tonebench.csv (flat chart rows), tonebench.json (metadata plus rows), tonebench-source.json (downloaded public original). Columns include benchmark, version, snapshot, model, effort, cost_usd, score, score_name, n, cost_basis, source_url, notes, time_s, Elo interval, generation dates, route and variant.

## Coverage and plotting

- Opus5.5, Sonnet5.5, Haiku5.5 and GPT6.1Sol: five explicit low/medium/high/xhigh/max points each.
- GPT6Astra and GPT6Sol: provider-default (labeled medium) and explicit max only.
- GPT5.6Sol: provider-default (labeled low) and ultra only.
- GPT5.6Luna: provider-default (labeled medium) and ultra only.
- GPT6Luna: provider-default (labeled medium), explicit high and max.

The default rows have null source reasoning_effort and a separate source thinking label. Render defaults hollow; do not pretend they are experimentally set explicit efforts. Ultra is a Codex product/harness variant, not standard API reasoning effort; render as a separate marker, no standard-effort connecting line. Missing efforts remain missing. Scores are Writing Score, not generic intelligence or percentage of tasks passed. Use log USD/script x-axis, and explain truncated y-axis if used. Elo is ancillary and relative to the current board; maximum Writing Score and maximum Elo can differ.

## Measurement definition

Each point: 10 English AI-education YouTube script briefs, five drafts each (50), one editorial voice, fixed research packet, no external tools. Four automated judges plus computed components; no human preference validation. Version fingerprint: judge 2026-10-r6-owner-rubric-new-panel; generation 2026-10-r4-closed-book. Prior Reddit/ToneBench versions are incompatible.

Cost is provider-counted output including reasoning plus fixed prompt once, converted to API list-price equivalents for subscription routes. It is NOT actual subscription spending or quota, and the methodology does not establish full failed/retried-generation cost inclusion. Time explicitly includes retries until an accepted script. Therefore use label “API-equivalent USD/accepted script (retry cost scope unconfirmed)” and do not label this all-in business cost/success. Pricing data are copied as benchmark inputs, not asserted current official vendor rates.

Method: https://benchmark.towardsai.com/methodology.html
Source: https://benchmark.towardsai.com/data/leaderboard.json
Effort overview: https://benchmark.towardsai.com/thinking.html

## Decision-useful observations (same snapshot)

Opus xhigh/max: Writing Score85.83/85.93 at $1.003254/$2.582468; Elo2785.1/2783.0 with strongly overlapping intervals. Sonnet max84.60 at $1.382526 versus Opus high84.61 at $0.328337. GPT6Sol max83.52 at $0.126466 versus Astra max82.32 at $1.154377. GPT6.1Sol xhigh/max82.39/82.44 at $0.198978/$0.238592. These are this writing rubric's measurements, not general model quality. Small score gaps should not be narrated as certain winners; 10 fixed scripts cannot establish transfer to Chinese marketing copy.

views.title: Frontier v4 · 完整配置（含回退）
views.scope: 2026-09-22 至 24；Claude Code 2.1.280；23 道二进制重建题 × 5 档，各一次。所有失败均保留在通过率、费用和耗时中。
columns: 回退任务；4.8 回复占比
views.takeaway: 这批实际配置中，medium 已 23/23 通过；max 更贵且少通过两题。可用于评估当时的默认回退工作流，不能归因为纯 Opus 5.5 的升档效果。
views.caveat: medium 及以上包含 Opus 4.8。high 有一个安全停止产生空补丁：完整通过为 22/23，综合分只评审 22 份。SE 是任务间标准误，不是档位差分的置信区间；费用为含回退的 CLI API 等价总价。

views.title: Frontier v4 · 共同无回退 6 题（探索性）

views.takeaway: 在这 6 题中 medium 起均全部通过；high 的均费和耗时比 medium 低。样本太小且经事后筛选，不能据此宣布 high 或 medium 是普遍甜蜜点。
views.caveat: 这是按运行后的回退事件筛出的子集，排除了 17/23 题，仍有选择偏差。不能代表整套 23 题，也不是关闭回退后重跑的实验。各档分别删回退会留下 23/20/16/15/11 道不同题，更不能直接比较。未新跑模型，未做显著性检验。

views.title: 官方 SWE-bench Pro 子集（独立实验）
views.scope: Anthropic 自测，2026-09-19 至 20；经评测环境筛选后 478 题。low/medium/high 各两轮，xhigh 一轮；每次响应上限 16,384 token。
views.takeaway: medium→high 多解决 2.5 个百分点；high→xhigh 再增 1.4 个百分点，费用约为 high 的 2.5 倍。对较长编码任务，medium 可作成本起点，high 用于优先提高完成率。
